verses.original: הֵ֥ן מֶ֑לֶךְ יִמְלָךְ־ לְצֶ֖דֶק וּלְשָׂרִ֖ים יָשֹֽׂרוּ׃ לְמִשְׁפָּ֥ט
verses.transliteration: hên me·leḵ yim·lāḵ- lə·ṣe·ḏeq ū·lə·śā·rîm yā·śō·rū lə·miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: Behold a king will reign in righteousness and princes will rule with justice

verses.original: אִ֥ישׁ וְהָיָה־ כְּמַֽחֲבֵא־ ר֖וּחַ וְסֵ֣תֶר זָ֑רֶם כְּפַלְגֵי־ מַ֣יִם בְּצָי֔וֹן כְּצֵ֥ל כָּבֵ֖ד סֶֽלַע־ עֲיֵפָֽה׃ בְּאֶ֥רֶץ
verses.transliteration: ’îš wə·hā·yāh- kə·ma·ḥă·ḇê- rū·aḥ wə·sê·ṯer zā·rem kə·p̄al·ḡê- ma·yim bə·ṣā·yō·wn kə·ṣêl kā·ḇêḏ se·la‘- ‘ă·yê·p̄āh bə·’e·reṣ
verses.literal: Each will be like a shelter from the wind a refuge from the storm like streams of water in a dry land like the shadow of a great rock in an arid land

verses.original: עֵינֵ֣י רֹאִ֑ים וְלֹ֥א תִשְׁעֶ֖ינָה וְאָזְנֵ֥י שֹׁמְעִ֖ים תִּקְשַֽׁבְנָה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·nê rō·’îm wə·lō ṯiš·‘e·nāh wə·’ā·zə·nê šō·mə·‘îm tiq·šaḇ·nāh
verses.literal: Then the eyes of those who see will no longer be closed and the ears of those who hear will listen

verses.original: וּלְבַ֥ב נִמְהָרִ֖ים יָבִ֣ין לָדָ֑עַת עִלְּגִ֔ים וּלְשׁ֣וֹן לְדַבֵּ֥ר צָחֽוֹת׃ תְּמַהֵ֖ר
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·ḇaḇ nim·hā·rîm yā·ḇîn lā·ḏā·‘aṯ ‘il·lə·ḡîm ū·lə·šō·wn lə·ḏab·bêr ṣā·ḥō·wṯ tə·ma·hêr
verses.literal: The mind of the rash will know and understand and the stammering tongue will speak clearly and fluently

verses.original: לֹֽא־ ע֛וֹד לְנָבָ֖ל יִקָּרֵ֥א נָדִ֑יב לֹ֥א וּלְכִילַ֕י יֵֽאָמֵ֖ר שֽׁוֹעַ׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ‘ō·wḏ lə·nā·ḇāl yiq·qā·rê nā·ḏîḇ lō ū·lə·ḵî·lay yê·’ā·mêr šō·w·a‘
verses.literal: No longer {will} a fool be called noble nor a scoundrel vvv be respected

verses.original: כִּ֤י נָבָל֙ יְדַבֵּ֔ר נְבָלָ֣ה וְלִבּ֖וֹ יַעֲשֶׂה־ אָ֑וֶן לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת חֹ֗נֶף וּלְדַבֵּ֤ר תּוֹעָ֔ה אֶל־ יְהוָה֙ נֶ֣פֶשׁ רָעֵ֔ב לְהָרִיק֙ צָמֵ֖א יַחְסִֽיר׃ וּמַשְׁקֶ֥ה
verses.transliteration: kî nā·ḇāl yə·ḏab·bêr nə·ḇā·lāh wə·lib·bōw ya·‘ă·śeh- ’ā·wen la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ḥō·nep̄ ū·lə·ḏab·bêr tō·w·‘āh ’el- Yah·weh ne·p̄eš rā·‘êḇ lə·hā·rîq ṣā·mê yaḥ·sîr ū·maš·qeh
verses.literal: For a fool speaks foolishness his mind plots iniquity He practices ungodliness and speaks falsely about the LORD he leaves the hungry . . . empty and deprives the thirsty of drink

verses.original: כֵּלָ֣יו וְכֵלַ֖י רָעִ֑ים ה֚וּא יָעָ֔ץ זִמּ֣וֹת לְחַבֵּ֤ל עֲנָוִים בְּאִמְרֵי־ שֶׁ֔קֶר וּבְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶבְי֖וֹן מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: kê·lāw wə·ḵê·lay rā·‘îm hū yā·‘āṣ zim·mō·wṯ lə·ḥab·bêl ʿă·nå̄·wīm bə·’im·rê- še·qer ū·ḇə·ḏab·bêr ’eḇ·yō·wn miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: The weapons of the scoundrel are destructive he hatches plots to destroy the poor with lies . . . even when the plea of the needy is just

verses.original: וְנָדִ֖יב יָעָ֑ץ נְדִיב֣וֹת וְה֖וּא יָקֽוּם׃פ עַל־ נְדִיב֥וֹת
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ḏîḇ yā·‘āṣ nə·ḏî·ḇō·wṯ wə·hū yā·qūm ‘al- nə·ḏî·ḇō·wṯ
verses.literal: But a noble man makes honorable plans he stands up for worthy causes

verses.original: קֹ֖מְנָה שַֽׁאֲנַנּ֔וֹת נָשִׁים֙ שְׁמַ֣עְנָה קוֹלִ֑י הַאְזֵ֖נָּה אִמְרָתִֽי׃ בֹּֽטח֔וֹת בָּנוֹת֙
verses.transliteration: qō·mə·nāh ša·’ă·nan·nō·wṯ nā·šîm šə·ma‘·nāh qō·w·lî ha’·zên·nāh ’im·rā·ṯî bō·ṭ·ḥō·wṯ bā·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: Stand up you complacent women listen to me . . . Give ear to my word you overconfident daughters

verses.original: יָמִים֙ עַל־ שָׁנָ֔ה תִּרְגַּ֖זְנָה בֹּֽטְח֑וֹת כִּ֚י בָצִ֔יר כָּלָ֣ה אֹ֖סֶף בְּלִ֥י יָבֽוֹא׃
verses.transliteration: yā·mîm ‘al- šā·nāh tir·gaz·nāh bō·ṭə·ḥō·wṯ kî ḇā·ṣîr kā·lāh ’ō·sep̄ bə·lî yā·ḇō·w
verses.literal: In a little more than . . . a year you will tremble O secure ones For the grape harvest will fail and the fruit harvest will not arrive

verses.original: חִרְדוּ֙ שַֽׁאֲנַנּ֔וֹת רְגָ֖זָה בֹּֽטְח֑וֹת פְּשֹׁ֣טָֽה וְעֹ֔רָה וַחֲג֖וֹרָה עַל־ חֲלָצָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ḥir·ḏū ša·’ă·nan·nō·wṯ rə·ḡā·zāh bō·ṭə·ḥō·wṯ pə·šō·ṭāh wə·‘ō·rāh wa·ḥă·ḡō·w·rāh ‘al- ḥă·lā·ṣā·yim
verses.literal: Shudder you ladies of leisure tremble you daughters of complacency Strip yourselves bare and put sackcloth around your waists

verses.original: סֹֽפְדִ֑ים עַל־ שָׁדַ֖יִם עַל־ חֶ֕מֶד עַל־ שְׂדֵי־ פֹּרִיָּֽה׃ גֶּ֖פֶן
verses.transliteration: sō·p̄ə·ḏîm ‘al- šā·ḏa·yim ‘al- ḥe·meḏ ‘al- śə·ḏê- pō·rî·yāh ge·p̄en
verses.literal: Beat - your breasts for the pleasant . . . fields for the fruitful vines

verses.original: עַ֚ל אַדְמַ֣ת עַמִּ֔י תַּֽעֲלֶ֑ה ק֥וֹץ שָׁמִ֖יר כִּ֚י עַל־ כָּל־ בָּתֵּ֣י מָשׂ֔וֹשׂ קִרְיָ֖ה עַלִּיזָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al ’aḏ·maṯ ‘am·mî ta·‘ă·leh qō·wṣ šā·mîr kî ‘al- kāl- bāt·tê mā·śō·wś qir·yāh ‘al·lî·zāh
verses.literal: and for the land of my people overgrown with thorns and briers even for every house of merriment in this city of revelry

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אַרְמ֣וֹן נֻטָּ֔שׁ הֲמ֥וֹן עִ֖יר עֻזָּ֑ב עֹ֣פֶל וָבַ֜חַן הָיָ֨ה בְעַ֤ד מְעָרוֹת֙ עַד־ עוֹלָ֔ם מְשׂ֥וֹשׂ פְּרָאִ֖ים מִרְעֵ֥ה עֲדָרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’ar·mō·wn nuṭ·ṭāš hă·mō·wn ‘îr ‘uz·zāḇ ‘ō·p̄el wā·ḇa·ḥan hā·yāh ḇə·‘aḏ mə·‘ā·rō·wṯ ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām mə·śō·wś pə·rā·’îm mir·‘êh ‘ă·ḏā·rîm
verses.literal: For the palace will be forsaken the busy city abandoned The hill and the watchtower will become - caves forever . . . the delight of wild donkeys and a pasture for flocks

verses.original: עַד־ ר֖וּחַ יֵ֨עָרֶ֥ה עָלֵ֛ינוּ מִמָּר֑וֹם מִדְבָּר֙ וְהָיָ֤ה לַכַּרְמֶ֔ל וְכַרְמֶל יֵחָשֵֽׁב׃ לַיַּ֥עַר
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ- rū·aḥ yê·‘ā·reh ‘ā·lê·nū mim·mā·rō·wm miḏ·bār wə·hā·yāh lak·kar·mel wə·ḵar·mɛl yê·ḥā·šêḇ lay·ya·‘ar
verses.literal: until the Spirit is poured out upon us from on high Then the desert will be an orchard and the orchard will seem like a forest

verses.original: מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וְשָׁכַ֥ן בַּמִּדְבָּ֖ר וּצְדָקָ֖ה תֵּשֵֽׁב׃ בַּכַּרְמֶ֥ל
verses.transliteration: miš·pāṭ wə·šā·ḵan bam·miḏ·bār ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh tê·šêḇ bak·kar·mel
verses.literal: Then justice will inhabit the wilderness and righteousness will dwell in the fertile field

verses.original: מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה הַצְּדָקָ֖ה וְהָיָ֛ה שָׁל֑וֹם וַֽעֲבֹדַת֙ הַצְּדָקָ֔ה הַשְׁקֵ֥ט וָבֶ֖טַח עַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ma·‘ă·śêh haṣ·ṣə·ḏā·qāh wə·hā·yāh šā·lō·wm wa·‘ă·ḇō·ḏaṯ haṣ·ṣə·ḏā·qāh haš·qêṭ wā·ḇe·ṭaḥ ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: The work of righteousness will be peace the service of righteousness will be quiet confidence forever . . .

verses.original: עַמִּ֖י וְיָשַׁ֥ב שָׁל֑וֹם וּֽבְמִשְׁכְּנוֹת֙ בִּנְוֵ֣ה מִבְטַחִ֔ים שַׁאֲנַנּֽוֹת׃ וּבִמְנוּחֹ֖ת
verses.transliteration: ‘am·mî wə·yā·šaḇ šā·lō·wm ū·ḇə·miš·kə·nō·wṯ bin·wêh miḇ·ṭa·ḥîm ša·’ă·nan·nō·wṯ ū·ḇim·nū·ḥōṯ
verses.literal: Then my people will dwell in a peaceful . . . place in safe and secure places of rest

verses.original: וּבָרַ֖ד בְּרֶ֣דֶת הַיָּ֑עַר הָעִֽיר׃ תִּשְׁפַּ֥ל וּבַשִּׁפְלָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·raḏ bə·re·ḏeṯ hay·yā·‘ar hā·‘îr tiš·pal ū·ḇaš·šip̄·lāh
verses.literal: But hail will level the forest and the city will sink to the depths

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵיכֶ֕ם זֹרְעֵ֖י עַל־ כָּל־ מָ֑יִם הַשּׁ֖וֹר וְהַחֲמֽוֹר׃ס מְשַׁלְּחֵ֥י רֶֽגֶל־
verses.transliteration: ’aš·rê·ḵem zō·rə·‘ê ‘al- kāl- mā·yim haš·šō·wr wə·ha·ḥă·mō·wr mə·šal·lə·ḥê re·ḡel-
verses.literal: Blessed [are] those who sow beside abundant waters who let the ox and donkey range freely . . .
